newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Getronics raises RAET stake to 100 pct.
newsitem.headline: Getronics raises RAET stake to 100 pct.

text.p: Getronics NV said on Monday it had raised its stake in RAET NV to 100 percent by acquiring the 50 percent stake previously held by Roccade Informatica Groep.
Getronics said it had paid for the 50 percent stake in cash from its own resources.
It said the deal would have a positive effect on its expected earnings per share in 1996 and that a substantial contribution was also expected for 1997.
Getronics said its takeover of RAET NV was prompted by the Dutch government's obstruction of a merger between Getronics and Roccade which is owned by the government.
Getronics provides systems and services in the fields of information and communication technology. It had annual sales in 1995 of 1.7 billion guilders. RAET is a software company.
Getronics said sales and operating profits of most RAET units had developed better than expected in 1996.
